themes.name: Digital Civic Access
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they improve residents’ ability to access municipal services, city information, or internet connectivity through digital tools or assisted service channels.

themes.name: Waste, Pollution and Energy
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they reduce pollution or resource use through renewable energy, disposable-material limits, environmental monitoring, recycling, or waste collection.

themes.name: School Learning Support
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they improve school-age children’s learning, school facilities, classroom conditions, meals, teacher retention, or educational instruction.

themes.name: Public Culture and Libraries
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they expand access to public cultural events, museums, public art, libraries, or shared cultural venues.

themes.name: Housing Affordability and Quality
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they increase housing supply or affordability, improve residential buildings, or provide renters with housing-market information.

themes.name: Local Jobs and Small Business
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they support workers’ career opportunities, local hiring, freelancers, business licensing, or financing for local businesses.

themes.name: Healthcare and Care Services
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they improve access to physical healthcare, mental-health treatment, preventive care, or in-home support for older residents.

themes.name: Neighborhood Safety and Response
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they prevent crime or street danger through policing, surveillance, traffic calming, lighting, or faster emergency response.

themes.name: Public Transit and Cycling
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they improve public-transit service, fares, rider information, late-night or peak operations, or dedicated cycling infrastructure.

themes.name: Parks and Outdoor Recreation
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they create or improve accessible parks, playgrounds, street greenery, dog areas, or shared community gardens.
